lines.en: Excuse me, officer. Is this a parking ticket?
lines.pt: Com licença, oficial. Isto é uma multa de estacionamento?

lines.en: Yes. You parked in a no-parking zone.
lines.pt: Sim. A senhora estacionou em uma zona proibida.

lines.en: Oh no. I didn’t see the sign.
lines.pt: Ah, não. Eu não vi a placa.

lines.en: It’s on the pole, next to the tree.
lines.pt: Está no poste, ao lado da árvore.

lines.en: It’s fifty dollars. You can pay online or at city hall.

lines.en: It’s on Main Street, across from the library.
lines.pt: Fica na Main Street, em frente à biblioteca.

lines.en: And where can I park legally?

lines.pt: Há uma garagem na esquina. Custa dois dólares por hora.

lines.en: Thank you. I’ll pay the ticket today.

facts.big: Is this…? · How much is…? · Where is…?
facts.label: Multa de estacionamento
facts.sub: Pergunte Is this a parking ticket? Diga I didn’t see the sign. Pergunte How much is the fine? e Where is city hall? Pergunte Where can I park legally?

facts.label: Placas de estacionamento

facts.label: A multa
facts.sub: Se você parar em local proibido, a oficial deixa a multa sob o limpador do para-brisa. Ela mostra o valor e o prazo para pagar.

pages.title: A white paper · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday afternoon on a busy street in Boston. Ana comes out of a shop with a small bag. She sees a white paper under her windshield wiper. A parking officer is writing on a tablet nearby. Ana walks up to her with a worried face. She asks about the paper.
“Excuse me, officer. Is this a parking ticket?” says Ana. “Yes. You parked in a no-parking zone.” says Officer Kim. “Oh no. I didn’t see the sign.” says Ana.
